idea-plugin.name: Pytest Run Params
idea-plugin.description:
pytest run options as checkboxes, and a progress counter that helps to rerun a module or a folder until everything is green.

Run options

  • The PytestParams tab is always in the Run panel, the first one (the tabs of the real runs come after it); it cannot be closed. The Pytest Params button on the left sidebar opens the Run panel on it, so it can be opened right after the IDE starts; the IDE's own Run button opens the standard panel with the latest real run. The tab has a Run button at the top, in the middle, and two columns (Clean Up Module, the progress counters and the reset button are on the toolbar of the Run tabs). Left: the options, Standard first and Custom after, every row with a drag handle, a checkbox, a value and a remove button; the + button opens the window that adds a standard option from a list or a custom one. Right: what to run — the directories, modules and tests of the project with checkboxes, a search by test id or name (several ids separated by comma or space; a test is shown with the name of the case from its docstring, cut with «…» where the row ends); a double click on a module or a test opens it in the editor. The ticks and the search are kept; the directories and modules with ticked tests move to the top 0.2 s after the last tick, the tests of a module keep their order; the tree does not scroll after the moved row; the Run button runs what is ticked. Add to Sequence (right click on the name of a test in the editor, or on test modules and directories in the Project view) ticks them in the tree.
  • Values to choose from: the window of the + button has separate fields: Title (the name of the checkbox, optional), Parameter (--serial) and Options (Samsung: R58M123456A, Pixel: 1A2B3C4D5E6F). With options it makes one option with a dropdown: a checkbox (named Title, or the option itself) and a choice between «Samsung: R58M123456A» and «Pixel: 1A2B3C4D5E6F». The selected value is what the option passes.
  • Options that conftest.py declares as integers with default 0 or 1 show as a single checkbox that sets the value: checked is =1, unchecked is =0.
  • The same checkboxes are on the Run tab toolbar of pytest runs and in the status bar; the gear on the toolbar and «Edit…» in the status bar menu open the PytestParams tab.
  • Enabled options become the Additional Arguments of the pytest template and of temporary (▶) configurations. Saved configurations are left untouched: on the Run tab of a saved configuration the checkboxes edit that configuration's own arguments.
  • The Run button of the tab runs what is ticked on the right with these options as a temporary configuration (a single directory or module as itself: its progress is counted; several, or tests, as one run of the selection: not counted); with nothing ticked — the counted module or folder, else the tests folder. The run is shown in its own tab.

Progress and clean-up

  • The Run tab toolbar counts passed (✔), failed (✖) and not run (○) tests of the module (a test file) or the folder you ran. A run of another module or folder starts the count from scratch; a module, a subfolder or a single test inside the counted folder adds to its progress.
  • Click the counters to see every test with its status. A click on a test moves it to the next status (passed, not run, failed), Cmd/Ctrl-click opens the test. The button next to the counters resets the progress: the results are forgotten.
  • Clean Up Module (the broom button next to the counters) runs only the failed and not run tests of the counted module or folder: passed tests are skipped with --deselect for that one run, Rerun and ▶ run everything again.

pytest and Autodetect test configurations are supported. Options and progress are stored per project in .idea/workspace.xml; what is written and shown is set in Settings | Tools | Pytest Run Params.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.19.0

  • A PytestParams tab, always in the Run panel and the first one (real runs come after it, it cannot be closed), opened by a button on the left sidebar. A Run button at the top, in the middle (Clean Up Module, the counters and the reset-progress button are on the toolbar of the Run tabs; the reset button is no longer in the counter's list). Left column: the options (Standard, then Custom) and a + at the right of the Params title that opens the window that adds one. Right column: what to run — a tree of directories, modules and tests with checkboxes, a search by id or name; a test shows the name of the case from its docstring, cut with «…»; a double click opens a module or a test in the editor; Run runs what is ticked.
  • An option with a dropdown of values: [Title:] --serial={Samsung: ID1, Pixel: ID2}. (The separate Samsung and Pixel rows of the earlier build become one such row.)
  • Add to Sequence in the editor menu (on the name of a test) and in the Project view menu (on test modules and directories) ticks them in the PytestParams tab; the directories and modules with ticked tests are shown first.
  • The IDE's own Run button opens the standard Run panel with the latest real run, not the PytestParams tab.
  • Removed from the Project view menu: Run with Pytest Params and Clean Up Module (Clean Up Module stays on the Run toolbar).

1.18.2

  • Requires IDE 2024.3 or newer: the progress counter and popup use IDE API that older versions do not have, so the plugin could not work there.
  • The list of standard options no longer uses SimpleListCellRenderer.create (scheduled for removal in the IDE).

1.18.1

  • Fixed: running a folder (e.g. tests) did not reset the counters, the tests were not counted and Clean Up Module reran the previous module. A folder is now counted like a module, over all test modules below it; Clean Up Module works for it, including the Project view menu of a folder.
  • No more deprecated, experimental or internal IDE APIs reported by the Plugin Verifier.

1.18.0

  • Progress popup: every test with its status, a click moves it to the next one, Cmd/Ctrl-click opens the test.
  • Clean Up Module runs once, the permanent «Clean up module» toggle is gone.
  • Clean Up Module in the Project view menu of a test module: on the counted one it runs its clean-up, on another one it switches the counter to it and runs it.
